hero.tagline: I build modern, scalable and high-performance web applications.
hero.intro: Frontend Engineer with 3+ years of experience crafting fast, accessible and reusable interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Redux — from analytics dashboards to booking platforms used every day.

about.title: Engineering interfaces
paragraphs: I'm Yash — a Frontend Engineer based in Delhi/NCR. I started as an intern at All Friends Studio in 2022 and today I build web platforms at Asian Hospital, where my work sits between clean UI, solid APIs and measurable performance.
I care about the details users feel but rarely notice: a page that loads under three seconds, a dashboard that stays smooth with 50K+ records, a form that just works on every device.

philosophy.title: Performance is a feature
philosophy.text: Lazy loading, code splitting, lean payloads and Core Web Vitals aren't afterthoughts — they're part of the definition of done.

philosophy.title: Components over pages
philosophy.text: Component-driven architecture helped teams I worked with ship 25% faster. Reusable, well-typed building blocks scale better than one-off screens.

philosophy.title: Users first, always
philosophy.text: Responsive, accessible and SEO-friendly by default — because a beautiful UI that some people can't use isn't finished.

approach.title: Understand
approach.text: Break the problem down: users, data flow, edge cases and the constraints that actually matter.

approach.title: Architect
approach.text: Design state, component boundaries and API contracts before writing UI — Redux Toolkit, RTK Query and custom hooks where they earn their place.

approach.title: Build
approach.text: Ship small, typed, reusable pieces. Keep them testable with Jest and React Testing Library.

approach.title: Measure
approach.text: Profile with Lighthouse and DevTools, fix bottlenecks, and verify the improvement with real numbers.

journey.title: From intern to
journey.lead: Three years of shipping production frontends — dashboards, booking systems, multilingual sites and the performance work behind them.

experience.summary: Building and optimising the hospital's digital platforms end-to-end — from booking flows to Core Web Vitals.
points: Built the MERN-based Asian Labs Diagnostic Appointment System handling 150+ daily bookings with secure JWT auth and custom middleware.
Optimised APIs and MongoDB queries (indexes, lean queries, pagination), cutting response times and speeding up booking and test-listing pages.
Improved Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse scores with gzip, cache headers, smaller payloads, lazy loading and code splitting.
Revamped four hospital websites (WordPress + PHP + MySQL) with server-side caching and image/HTML optimisation.

experience.summary: Shipped product UIs for clients across analytics, gaming, e-commerce and corporate web.
points: Designed onWork.ai and delivered a React + Google Charts analytics dashboard processing 50K+ records, reducing reporting time by 60%.
Integrated OTP login and wallet management in a React gaming platform with Node.js, Express and JWT, improving retention by 20%.
Built a multilingual corporate website for US-based client DWFritz in three languages with React and Tailwind CSS.
Reduced bundle size and optimised components for an e-commerce platform, significantly lowering mobile bounce rate.

experience.summary: Where it started — performance tuning and SEO on real client projects.
points: Improved site load times to under 3s for Farmscan Australia through React performance tuning.
Customised WordPress themes with SEO improvements, driving +18% organic traffic.
